svg.title: Bandwidth: too small, about right and too large
svg.desc: The same 110 test scores drawn as three density curves with different bandwidths. With a bandwidth of 0.9 the curve is jagged, with many small spikes. With a bandwidth of 4 it shows two clear peaks, near 52 and near 76. With a bandwidth of 14 it is one wide, smooth hump and the second peak disappears.
svg.text: Spiky: noise looks like real peaks
